_about: Image-model bench, October 2026: twelve prompts whose facts can be checked, one picture per model per prompt, scored by OCR where the check is text and by a Claude judge (one yes/no question per fact, the TIFA/DSG method) otherwise. scripts/image-bench.py runs it; docs/market-image-video-models-2026.md is the design.

prompts.prompt: A photo of a small bakery storefront in the morning. Above the door, a wooden sign reads exactly: GRAND OPENING. Below the window, a small chalkboard reads exactly: Saturday 10 AM.

checks.q: Is the main sign's text exactly GRAND OPENING, spelled correctly?
Is there a small chalkboard whose text is exactly 'Saturday 10 AM'?
Is it a bakery or shop front with a door and a wooden sign above it?

prompts.prompt: A minimalist poster pasted on a brick wall. Three lines of large bold text, one under another: THE NIGHT MARKET / EVERY FRIDAY / 6 PM TO MIDNIGHT. A small paper lantern illustration under the text.

checks.q: Are there exactly three lines of headline text, in the order THE NIGHT MARKET, EVERY FRIDAY, 6 PM TO MIDNIGHT, all spelled correctly?
Is there a small lantern illustration below the text?
Is the poster on a brick wall?

prompts.prompt: A cafe chalkboard sign on an easel on a sidewalk. Written in white chalk, the Ukrainian words: Кава з собою

checks.q: Does the chalkboard read exactly 'Кава з собою' in Cyrillic, every letter correct (no Latin look-alikes, no missing or extra letters)?
Is it a chalkboard on an easel on a sidewalk?

prompts.prompt: Top-down photo of a white plate on a wooden table with exactly four red apples and exactly two green pears on it, and nothing else on the plate.

checks.q: Are there exactly four red apples on the plate? Count them.
Are there exactly two green pears on the plate? Count them.
Is there nothing else on the plate besides the apples and pears?

prompts.prompt: On a wooden desk: a blue mug on the left, a yellow book on the right, and a black pen lying on top of the yellow book. Plain wall behind.

checks.q: Is the mug blue and on the left side of the desk?
Is the book yellow and on the right side?
Is a black pen lying on top of the yellow book (not beside it)?

prompts.prompt: A girl in a red coat holding a green umbrella stands next to a boy in a yellow raincoat holding a blue umbrella, on a rainy street.

checks.q: Is the girl wearing a red coat?
Is the girl holding a green umbrella?
Is the boy wearing a yellow raincoat?
Is the boy holding a blue umbrella?

prompts.prompt: An empty city street at dawn with no people, no cars, and no signs, letters or text anywhere in the picture.

checks.q: Is the picture free of any people?
Is the picture free of any cars or vehicles?
Is the picture free of any signs, letters or text?

prompts.prompt: Close-up photo of two hands playing a grand piano, natural daylight.

checks.q: Are there exactly two hands?
Does every visible hand have five fingers and plausible joints (no fused, extra or missing fingers)?
Do the piano keys look regular (black keys in groups of two and three, no melted keys)?

prompts.prompt: Photorealistic portrait of an elderly fisherman with a grey beard, wearing a yellow raincoat, holding a silver fish, a harbor with boats behind him, golden hour light.

checks.q: Is he an elderly man with a grey beard?
Is he wearing a yellow raincoat?
Is he holding a silver fish?
Is there a harbor with boats behind him?
Does it look like a photograph rather than a painting or render?

prompts.prompt: Product photo of a white sneaker with the word KITCUT printed on its side, on a pastel pink background, soft studio lighting.

checks.q: Is the word on the shoe exactly KITCUT, spelled correctly?
Is it a white sneaker?
Is the background pastel pink?

prompts.prompt: A clean flat infographic on a white background: three labelled steps in a row from left to right, Write, Draw, Publish, connected by arrows.

checks.q: Are there exactly three steps, labelled Write, Draw and Publish, in that order from left to right?
Are the steps connected by arrows pointing left to right?
Is the background white and the style flat (not photographic)?

prompts.prompt: A watercolor painting of a red fox sitting in a snowy forest, visible paper texture and soft washes.

checks.q: Does it look like a watercolor painting (soft washes, visible paper texture), not a photo or digital render?
Is there a red fox, sitting?
Is the setting a snowy forest?
